forum.title: STM32CubeProgrammer installer stuck at Step 8 on Windows 11 Single Language
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @goktug1,

Apologies for the delayed response.

It appears that this issue happens when installing on Windows 11 using certain languages other than english.

Fortunately, when you reach the step 8 all that is left is the shortcut creation and if you check the installation folder (which by default should be "*C:\Program Files\STMicroelectronics\STM32Cube\STM32CubeProgrammer*") everything should be there.

If you wish to create a shortcut of STM32CubeProgrammer, please head over to the **\bin\**folder and send a shortcut of **STM32CubeProgrammer.exe** to your desired location.

Please let me know if you require more assistance on this matter.
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I tried to install STM32CubeProgrammer, but the installer always gets stuck at Step 8. I searched online and found that some people from my country solved the problem by changing the Windows region and language.

However, my Windows 11 license only supports a single language, so I cannot change it.

Is there any other solution for this issue?

Thanks in advance.
